assets.name: board-luxury
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square 2D mobile gomoku board surface texture, production game sprite. An exquisite premium dark rosewood / walnut lacquer playing surface, perfectly flat orthographic overhead, square edge to edge, no perspective. Rich restrained espresso brown wood with fine elegant longitudinal grain and a warm satin polish, subtle hand-crafted depth, evenly lit, moderate brightness so both black and ivory stones remain readable. Quiet low-frequency texture appropriate underneath a precise gold grid that will be drawn separately by code. Entire image is just the usable material surface. No grid, no lines, no border, no stones, no objects, no lettering, no symbols, no highlights obscuring play, no watermark. Not a scene or mockup. Square.

assets.name: board-inferno
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square seamless-looking 2D mobile gomoku board surface texture, production game sprite. INFERNO theme: a pitch-black cooled volcanic obsidian playing surface, perfectly flat orthographic overhead, square edge to edge. Near-black charcoal and subtle deep burgundy stone, finely weathered dense volcanic microtexture, minimal subtle edge-vignette. The central 90 percent must be quiet, very dark, evenly lit and uncluttered; a glowing red-orange precise grid will be drawn over it separately by code. Luxurious ominous polished basalt, restrained infernal mood. Entire image is bare material. No grid, no lines, no bright cracks, no lava river, no flames, no border, no stones or objects, no text, no symbols, no perspective, no watermark. Square.

assets.name: stone-luxury-black
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone 2D top-down gomoku stone sprite, transparent background. A single circular domed polished black obsidian Go stone with a delicate champagne-gold beveled rim. Refined luxury board game craftsmanship, lustrous charcoal face and a crisp restrained upper-left pearl reflection, subtle organic mineral depth. Direct orthographic overhead, perfectly circular, centered. The solid stone occupies 88 percent of the square canvas diameter; transparent padding on every edge. Strong clean silhouette readable at 22px. Thin gold outline remains clear on dark walnut. Only the single stone, no board, no text, no backdrop, no pedestal, no other objects, no drop shadow outside the canvas. Genuine transparent alpha. Square.
